notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant in hand.You control less than two Thrulls.
description:
Cast Gray Merchant by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least four life and you to gain life equal to the life you gained this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing Gray Merchant and five Thrulls, adding {3}{B}{B}{B}.
The Thrulls and Grey Merchant die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer six times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and two life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
